rows.note: Meso H1 or Neo S8 or Axi A7, Uncommon: 20% Radiant; Lith F1 or Meso F1 or Axi F1, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Fragor Prime Head
rows.note: Lith V7 or Meso V8 or Neo H1 or Axi A1 or Axi B2 or Axi H1, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Fragor Prime Handle
rows.note: Lith V8 or Neo D6 or Neo T1 or Neo V6 or Axi C2 or Axi N4, Uncommon: 20% Radiant; Lith V1, Rare: 10% Radiant

conditions: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave Head relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.

bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.
